name: adapt_reverted_fix_java_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the agent's bug fix is REVERTED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, Calc.java rewritten back to the buggy version); the agent must notice and reapply the fix
prompts: Calc.java has a bug in add(int a, int b) - it currently subtracts instead of adding. Fix it so add(a, b) returns a + b.
Your fix to Calc.java seems to have been reverted - the subtraction bug is back. Please reapply the fix so add(a, b) correctly returns a + b.

disruptions.description: Calc.java reverted back to the buggy (subtraction) version
